class.name: PuzzleSolver
class.brief_description: Fast C++ implementation of Go puzzle solving for tsumego puzzles.
class.description: PuzzleSolver provides high-performance Go (Baduk) puzzle solving capabilities. It can find optimal solutions for tsumego puzzles and build complete game trees with opponent responses. This is significantly faster than GDScript implementations due to native C++ execution.

method.name: solve_puzzle
method.description: Finds a winning solution for the given puzzle. [code]board_2d[/code]: 2D array representing the board state (0=empty, 1=black, 2=white). [code]player_color[/code]: The color of the player to move (1=black, 2=white). [code]target_stones[/code]: Array of [x, y] positions that must be captured. If empty, all opponent stones must be captured. [code]max_moves[/code]: Maximum number of player moves to search. Returns a Dictionary with: - "found": bool - whether a solution was found - "player_moves": Array of [x, y] positions for player moves - "opponent_moves": Array of [x, y] positions for opponent responses

method.name: build_game_tree
method.description: Builds a complete game tree with opponent responses for all possible player moves. This allows the puzzle to respond to any player move, not just the optimal solution. Returns a Dictionary mapping board state hashes to [x, y] opponent responses.

method.name: simulate_single_move
method.description: Simulates a single move on the board. Returns the resulting board state as a 2D array, or an empty array if the move is invalid.

method.name: is_goal_achieved
method.description: Checks if the puzzle goal has been achieved (target stones captured or no opponent stones remain).
